## Government services (checked dates on each page)

- How to change your address in Aadhaar (online): Where — myAadhaar portal (from uidai.gov.in); You need — Mobile number linked to Aadhaar (for OTP); Fee — Shown on the portal — ₹75 at present as per UIDAI; Time — Usually a few days, up to 30 days. Official site: https://myaadhaar.uidai.gov.in/ — https://nextgrade.in/en/sarkari-guide/aadhaar-address-change/
- How to link PAN with Aadhaar: Where — Income Tax e-filing portal (incometax.gov.in); Fee — ₹1,000 (late linking fee) — paid first; You need — PAN, Aadhaar, mobile linked to Aadhaar; Why — An unlinked PAN can become inoperative. Official site: https://www.incometax.gov.in/iec/foportal/ — https://nextgrade.in/en/sarkari-guide/pan-aadhaar-link/
- How to get a new PAN card: Easiest — Instant e-PAN with Aadhaar — on incometax.gov.in, free; You need — Aadhaar + the mobile linked to it; Physical card — From Protean (NSDL) or UTIITSL — fee shown on the portal; Time — e-PAN in minutes to hours; card by post in a few weeks. Official site: https://www.incometax.gov.in/iec/foportal/ — https://nextgrade.in/en/sarkari-guide/pan-card-apply/
- How to get an Ayushman card (PM-JAY): Where — beneficiary.nha.gov.in or the Ayushman App; Fee — Making the card is free; You need — Aadhaar + mobile (OTP); Helpline — 14555. Official site: https://beneficiary.nha.gov.in/ — https://nextgrade.in/en/sarkari-guide/ayushman-card/
- How to download e-Aadhaar (Aadhaar PDF): Where — myAadhaar portal (from uidai.gov.in); Fee — Free; You need — Mobile linked to Aadhaar (OTP); PDF password — First 4 letters of name (CAPITALS) + birth year. Official site: https://myaadhaar.uidai.gov.in/ — https://nextgrade.in/en/sarkari-guide/e-aadhaar-download/
- How to get a new voter ID (Form 6): Where — voters.eci.gov.in or the Voter Helpline app; Fee — Free; Who — Indian citizens aged 18 or above; Form — New name: Form 6 (living abroad: 6A). Official site: https://voters.eci.gov.in/ — https://nextgrade.in/en/sarkari-guide/voter-id-apply/
- How to apply for a passport (online): Where — Passport Seva portal (passportindia.gov.in) / mPassport Seva app; Fee (36 pages) — Normal ₹2,500 · Tatkaal ₹5,000 (from 1 July 2026); 60 pages — Normal ₹3,500 · Tatkaal ₹6,000; Under 18 — 36 pages normal ₹1,750. Official site: https://www.passportindia.gov.in/ — https://nextgrade.in/en/sarkari-guide/passport-apply/
- How to use DigiLocker: Where — digilocker.gov.in or the DigiLocker app; Fee — Free; You need — Mobile number + Aadhaar; Why — Official documents on your phone, valid like originals. Official site: https://www.digilocker.gov.in/ — https://nextgrade.in/en/sarkari-guide/digilocker/

## House construction (thumb rules, Nov 2026 estimate)

- Cost per sq ft: basic ₹1600–1900, standard ₹1900–2400, premium ₹2500–3500 (without land/interiors) — https://nextgrade.in/en/ghar-banane-ka-kharcha/
- Per sq ft of built-up area: cement 0.4 bag, steel 4 kg, bricks 8, sand 1.816 cft, aggregate 1.35 cft, paint 0.18 L, tiles 1.3 sq ft

## Rooftop solar (PM Surya Ghar subsidy, checked 26 Nov 2026)

- Central subsidy, residential: ₹30,000/kW for the first 2 kW + ₹18,000 for the 3rd kW → 1 kW ₹30,000, 2 kW ₹60,000, 3 kW+ ₹78,000 (cap); special category states ₹33,000 + ₹19,800 (max ₹85,800). Apply only at pmsuryaghar.gov.in — https://nextgrade.in/en/solar-calculator/
- Thumb rules: 1 kW makes ~120 units/month (~4/day), needs ~100 sq ft roof, installed cost ~₹55000–70000 per kW (estimate). 300 units/month → ~3 kW — https://nextgrade.in/en/solar-calculator/3-kw/
- Inverter: VA = load W ÷ 0.8; battery Ah = W × hours ÷ (V × 0.8); 12V 150Ah ≈ 1,800 Wh — https://nextgrade.in/en/inverter-calculator/

## Income tax, India — FY 2026-27 (tax year 2026-27; Budget 2026 kept the FY 2025-26 slabs; checked 27 Nov 2026)

- New regime (default): up to ₹4 lakh nil; ₹4–8 lakh 5%; ₹8–12 lakh 10%; ₹12–16 lakh 15%; ₹16–20 lakh 20%; ₹20–24 lakh 25%; above ₹24 lakh 30%. Standard deduction ₹75,000 (salary/pension). Rebate up to ₹60,000: no tax if taxable income ≤ ₹12 lakh (salary ≤ ₹12.75 lakh); marginal relief just above — https://nextgrade.in/en/calculator/income-tax/
- Old regime: up to ₹2.5 lakh nil (₹3 lakh at 60+, ₹5 lakh at 80+); ₹2.5–5 lakh 5%; ₹5–10 lakh 20%; above ₹10 lakh 30%. Standard deduction ₹50,000; rebate up to ₹12,500 if taxable income ≤ ₹5 lakh; 80C max ₹1.5 lakh, home-loan interest max ₹2 lakh.
- Surcharge 10% (>₹50 lakh), 15% (>₹1 crore), 25% (>₹2 crore; new regime cap), 37% (>₹5 crore, old regime); health and education cess 4%.
- Examples (new regime): salary ₹12.75 lakh → tax ₹0; salary ₹15 lakh → ₹97,500; CTC ₹10 lakh (basic 40%, PF ₹1,800/month, PT ₹200) → in-hand ≈ ₹79,500/month — https://nextgrade.in/en/calculator/salary/

## Number system

- Indian system: 1 lakh = 1,00,000 (100 thousand); 10 lakh = 1 million; 1 crore = 1,00,00,000 (10 million); 100 crore = 1 billion — https://nextgrade.in/en/number-in-words/
